mapper.select: select * from attempt_answer where attempt_id = #{attemptId} order by id
select * from attempt_answer where attempt_id = #{attemptId} and question_id = #{questionId}
mapper.insert: insert into attempt_answer (attempt_id, question_id, user_sql, auto_result, auto_message, user_result_json, expected_result_json, elapsed_ms, updated_at) values (#{attemptId}, #{questionId}, #{userSql}, #{autoResult}, #{autoMessage}, #{userResultJson}, #{expectedResultJson}, #{elapsedMs}, now()) on duplicate key update user_sql = values(user_sql), auto_result = values(auto_result), auto_message = values(auto_message), user_result_json = values(user_result_json), expected_result_json = values(expected_result_json), elapsed_ms = values(elapsed_ms), correct = null, review_comment = null, reviewed_by = null, reviewed_at = null, updated_at = now()
mapper.update: update attempt_answer set correct = #{correct}, review_comment = #{comment}, reviewed_by = #{reviewerId}, reviewed_at = now() where id = #{id} and attempt_id = #{attemptId}
